maps.name: Original cofactor and marked ES state
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Inverse u=pa^2/(Ry-pa), Q=N/R. Retain channel M and denominator order.

maps.name: Signed arithmetic relation to the imported two-power form
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Signs and positive exponents recover a,b. Lambda=11^-b(3^a11^b-1); multiplier is a 2-adic unit. Axes handled separately.

maps.name: Relation lattice coordinate equivalence
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Inverse (a,b)->((a+J_k*b)/o,b). Integral exactly on the declared kernel.

maps.name: Finite 2-adic logarithm observation
maps.domain: The convergent normalized log ratio modulo2^(k-3)
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Unique modular-power inverse label. The finite residue does not retain the full infinite 2-adic expansion.

maps.name: Exact basis reduction
maps.formula: Integer swaps and nearest multiple subtraction.
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Each operation is unimodular; reversing the retained trace returns the original ordered basis.

maps.name: Word selection by rounding
maps.domain: Target t and actual translated rectangle with proved widths
maps.codomain: Original exponent word plus basis coordinates
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: For fixed t,B, rounding coefficient fibre z is z+[-1/2,1/2)^2. Inverse on a selected word reads B^-1(w-(t,0)); it does not recover a discarded arbitrary centre.

maps.name: Complete bounded target fibre
maps.codomain: All original 3,11 exponent pairs at the target
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Integer factorization reads exponents; modular residue alone forgets the fibre.

maps.name: Prime-factor word to cofactor
maps.domain: (t,i,j) with t|M outside H and target i+Jj
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: i=v3(Q), j=v11(Q), t=Q/(3^i11^j). Unique, no coloured copies.

maps.name: Exact relative group isomorphism
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Read retained cyclic exponent and divide by2^v. This identifies relation lattices at precision k-v, not arbitrary fields or heights.

maps.name: Complete lower/higher digits
maps.codomain: Disjoint union of actual lower-digit/high-capacity rectangles
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Euclidean division; higher bounds floor((e-r)/d), floor((f-s)/d). No multiplicity renormalization.

maps.name: Relative target equation
maps.domain: One retained lower fibre meeting t-r-J_k*s=0 mod d
maps.formula: Divide the actual integer difference by d.
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Reverse by multiplying by d and restoring lower digits and original target representative. Incompatible lower fibres are not admitted.

maps.name: Relative boundary inclusion
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Inverse reads a coefficient per coset after the constant-coset image test. Module map, not a unital ring isomorphism.

maps.name: Ordinary coefficient quotient
maps.formula: Sum coefficients with same exponent modulo d.
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Kernel is the corresponding coset-sum-zero subspace. pi*iota=0 for a nontrivial 2-power ratio; not the inverse of R4.

maps.name: Coefficient reduction with supported zeros
maps.domain: Original integer coefficient counts plus original label set
maps.codomain: Same support set with amplitudes mod2
maps.formula: Reduce amplitudes, retain every presence label.
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Many-to-one amplitudes; retain original integer vector for full return. Even positive counts become e, never automatically tau.

maps.name: Disjoint-block counting lower bound
maps.domain: Disjoint actual exponent rectangles and outside t|M
maps.formula: Choose one target word per rectangle and multiply by t.
maps.inverse_fibres_and_loss: Unique factorization and disjoint rectangles make chosen states distinct; no sum over overlapping untracked families.
